question: Does external UTC add sensitivity to a constant decoded-UTC offset on three new sessions without adding original-log alarms on common support?

selection.rule: First three capture IDs initiated for this evaluation after this plan is committed, in initiation order; no replacement by reception, NTS success or result
selection.conditions: Stationary outdoors with sky view and Internet; same installed collector, no reboot; keep app visible
selection.schedule: Existing native ten rounds, three-second round-start spacing, both PTB endpoints; no new schedule or retries
selection.deadline_action: Stop the existing app session, retain its terminal and all planned slots, count it as incomplete; never start a replacement
selection.interruption_action: Retain every started or partial session; do not replace an interrupted, missing or invalid input
selection.value_access: Transport state, filenames and metadata may be read during collection; copy and hash all originals before numeric PC decoding; analyze only after the three slots have terminated

analysis_options.budget_source: Fixed uncalibrated development assumptions for this conditional evaluation; no independently qualified server or oscillator bounds
analysis_options.counter_resolution_source: Explicit unqualified 1 ns assumption; API units and NTS agreement do not establish effective resolution
analysis_options.association_source: Same installed native app process/session and declared boot metadata; trusted collector assertion, not hardware attestation
analysis_options.time_scale_source: IERS Leap_Second.dat, Bulletin C72, checked 2026-10-10: TAI-UTC 37 s minus GPS TAI offset 19 s; October 2026 only, no leap crossing
analysis_options.utc_error_source: Fixed unqualified 1 ms receiver UTC assumption; no receiver uncertainty or residual used as a bound
analysis_options.epoch_alignment_source: Predeclared unqualified 25 ms engineering assumption, one quarter of the 100 ms software challenge; not independent calibration or a bound derived from these evaluation observations

sensitivity.support: Existing zero-case common local/external support fixed for all offsets; require all member rows for a common clock group
sensitivity.rules: Existing paired patterns; no endpoint vote, one-method fallback, clock-domain stitching, fitting or new detector

metrics: Per-session completion/intake issues and every NTS status including unattempted slots
All GPS receiver records, reported clock groups, unidentified records and common support
Original and each offset: local, external and combined own/common record/group outcome counts
Original-log alarms retained without verified-benign or false-alarm labels; disagreements, mixed rows and missing support kept separate

interpretation.evaluable: All three planned sessions retained, schedule completed with admitted comparison and at least one common reported clock group each
interpretation.conditional_advantage_repeated: In every session: no inconclusive or mixed common groups in any case; each sign gives external and combined INCONSISTENT on every common group; local counts stay equal to zero; zero-case combined INCONSISTENT does not exceed local INCONSISTENT
interpretation.otherwise: Report non-repetition or non-evaluability with all sessions and cases; no parameter tuning, new offset grid or passing replacement in this evaluation
interpretation.claims: Three-session conditional observation only; originals not verified benign, sessions/groups not independent trials, no population rate, qualified timing budget, RF attack, ALLOW/BLOCK or P2/P3 closure
interpretation.prior_development: Design informed by already exposed phone studies; those inputs are excluded from these three evaluation slots
